title: CodeQL scanning workflow
summary: Code scanning runs again from a repository workflow after the organisation policy turned off default setup.
changes: Add a CodeQL workflow that scans GitHub Actions and JavaScript on pull requests, pushes to main and a weekly schedule.
Pin the CodeQL and checkout actions to full commit hashes.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.43 line: continuous integration only, with no application behaviour change.
validation: CodeQL workflow runs on the pull request.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: PHP is not scanned because CodeQL does not support it.
rollback: Remove the CodeQL workflow. No application or database change is involved.
